title: Class-Specific Storylines
content: The best-known class storyline is the Death Knight's: starting at level 55 in Acherus, the Ebon Hold, death knights serve the Lich King in the Scarlet Enclave of the Eastern Plaguelands, earn the Acherus Deathcharger, and break free at the Battle for Light's Hope Chapel before being sent to their faction's capital.

title: Zone Story Arcs
content: Each Northrend zone follows its own story: the vrykul of Utgarde in Howling Fjord, the blue dragonflight and the Nexus in Borean Tundra, the Wrathgate in Dragonblight, the Drakkari trolls' dying gods in Zul'Drak, Thorim and the secrets of Ulduar in the Storm Peaks, and the war on the Lich King's doorstep in Icecrown.

title: Reputation Quest Hubs
content: Northrend's reputation dailies: the Argent Tournament in Icecrown, the Sons of Hodir at Dun Niffelem in the Storm Peaks, the Kalu'ak at their fishing villages, and in Sholazar Basin either the Oracles or the Frenzyheart, since siding with one turns the other hostile.

title: Dungeon and Raid Quests
content: Dungeons usually have quests from NPCs at or just inside the entrance, so check before zoning in. In Dalaran, Archmage Lan'dalock gives the weekly raid quest to kill a named boss, such as Patchwerk Must Die! or Lord Marrowgar Must Die!, for extra Emblems.

title: Epic Quest Chains
content: A quest chain is a series where each quest unlocks the next. Wrath's long ones include the Wrathgate and the Battle for the Undercity, the Sons of Hodir chain in the Storm Peaks, Quel'Delar from the Battered Hilt, and Shadowmourne for Icecrown Citadel raiders.

title: Profession Quest Lines
content: Dalaran has the Northrend profession dailies: the Grand Master cooking trainers, Katherine Lee for the Alliance and Awilo Lon'gomba for the Horde, give cooking dailies paying Dalaran Cooking Awards; Marcia Chase gives a fishing daily; and Timothy Jones gives a jewelcrafting daily paying Dalaran Jewelcrafter's Tokens.

title: Escort and Protection Quests
content: In an escort quest the NPC walks a fixed route and fights beside you; if it dies the quest fails, and you abandon it and take it again once the NPC is back. Party members on the same quest who stay nearby all get credit.

title: Group and Raid Quests
content: Quests tagged Group in the log suggest a party size because their targets are elites, which show a gold dragon on their portrait. While you're in a raid group, ordinary quest kills and items don't count, only quests tagged Raid do, so convert back to a party to finish quests.

title: Repeatable and Daily Quests
content: Daily quests can be done once per day and reset at the realm's daily reset; you can finish up to 25 of them a day. Big Northrend daily hubs are the Argent Tournament, the Sons of Hodir and Wyrmrest Temple, plus the Dalaran cooking and fishing dailies. Some quests, like the raid weekly, reset once a week.
